result.title: LM-based Personalized Travel Planner
result.summary: Effective travel planning requires handling multiple information sources, managing constraints, and tailoring recommendations to user preferences. While LLMs have introduced dynamic, context-aware decision-making, single-agent models often struggle with complex multi-step reasoning, constraint adherence, and modular execution. To overcome these limitations, we propose a hierarchical multi-agent framework where a supervising chatbot agent coordinates specialized agents for schedule validation, user query formulation, real-time data retrieval, and constraint-aware itinerary generation. By integrating LLM reasoning, external APIs, and iterative refinement mechanisms based on a deterministic, multi-dimensional scoring framework, our approach ensures adaptability, efficiency, and personalization. Evaluations on the well-known TravelPlanner benchmark demonstrate improvements in Budget Constraint planning by 10\%, wider constraints set-based planning by 25\%, and personalized planning results by 45\%. compared to the ReAct baseline. Our code is available at https://github.com/nimashaklaa/TravelPlanner_Research

AI.brief_summary: 该论文提出一个分层多智能体旅行规划框架，由监督型 chatbot 协调日程校验、查询生成、实时数据检索与约束感知行程生成等专门智能体，并结合外部 API 与确定性多维评分的迭代精化；在 TravelPlanner 基准上相对 ReAct 报告了预算、约束集合与个性化规划的提升。
AI.relevance_reason: 属于文本 LLM 多智能体任务应用与刷分工作，无视觉或多模态推理，也未涉及 latent 状态表示、视觉证据使用、停止决策等具体机制线索，与 LVR 研究主线缺少实质联系。
